full_judgment: 2. The facts leading to the issuance of the Rule in a nutshell can be stated thus, the present petitioner as plaintiff instituted the original declaratory Suit being Title Suit No. 158 of 2006 in the Court of learned Senior Assistant Judge, Sadar, Noakhali for a declaration that the registered deed of gift being No. 13681 dated 12-8-1985 executed by one Ashwini Kumar Dey, the predecessor of the defendant Nos. 1-4 in favour of the defendant No. 1 Ratri Bala Dey is false, fraudulent, inoperative and not binding upon the plaintiff in respect of the land described in schedule-'ka' of the plaint. The learned trial court during trial after taking evidence from the sides of the respective parties dismissed the suit on contest by its judgment and decree dated 30-9-2009 and 7-10-2009 respectively.
